title: Repos for products of the early-ecosystem partners named in Anthropic's MHS announcement
description: Partner names follow MHS/spec/appendix-d-anthropic-mhs.md section 4 and only record whose product a repo drives; they claim no endorsement or affiliation. A partner flag adds 40 to the published rank score. Partners with no repo in the corpus: Doosan Robotics, QuEra, Tetsuwan, QIAGEN, Automata, Genentech, HHMI Janelia (only third-party Zaber code), CMU.

overrides.justification: FluentControlClient REST client for Tecan FluentControl with unit tests; a direct Driver over the client class.
SparkControlClient for the Tecan Spark plate reader through SparkControl; a direct Driver over the client class.
Tecan class driving a Fluent through the FluentControl execution channel (LiHa get/drop tips, aspirate, dispense, MCA); a direct Driver over that class.
Tecan Cavro OEM syringe pump; the OEM frame (address, sequence, checksum) and commands built from parts need a direct Driver over XCaliburD, not a SerialDriver table.
Generates Tecan EVO Gemini (.gem) programs; it does not talk to the instrument.
ROS 2 node for the Raspberry Pi camera module (MMAL; upstream recommends camera_ros); a ROS-helper member.
ScanimageTcpipClient(address, port) remote-controls ScanImage over JSON/TCP and ships dummy_json_server.py, which serves as the fake backend.
pip-installable Gymnasium env of the ALOHA bimanual robot on MuJoCo; a GymnasiumDriver family-config by env id.
pip-installable Gymnasium PushT env used by LeRobot policies; a GymnasiumDriver family-config by env id.
LeRobot robot abstraction (SO-100/101, Koch, LeKiwi, Reachy 2 and more) that the post-pilot LeRobot helper wraps; an SDK bridge task, not a repo task.
Web viewer for LeRobot datasets; tooling, no device.
LeRobot humanoid workspace with MJCF models and simulation identification; a MuJoCo twin candidate of the humanoid hardware.
Model review of wave B: a direct Driver, not a MujocoDriver: the LIBERO entry class parses a BDDL task file and builds a robosuite scene in its constructor; there is no raw MJCF model to load.
In-silico debugging and worklist generation for Tecan EVO/Fluent; it does not talk to the instrument.
Generates Fluent worklists (gwl) and labware tables offline; it does not talk to the instrument.
Python client for Leica microscope CAM (computer-assisted microscopy) socket control; a direct Driver over its socket client class.

Model review of the helper integration, 2026-11-05: a ROS 2 node that only publishes JPEG CompressedImage frames; its parameters are read once at start (ros2_raspicam_node.py:77, 88-91), so camera observation, R0, not configure.
strands_robots.Robot() drives a MuJoCo simulation by default and real robots with mode="real"; a direct Driver whose sim mode is the hardware-free backend.
Model review of wave C: a direct Driver over Cmd_delayed for a later run: frames are STX + sequence letter + device + command + ETX + XOR; the card stays blocked until a stop exists.
C++ client library underneath the UR ROS 2 driver; UR arms are integrated through gh.universalrobots/universal_robots_ros2_driver, not through this library.
Driver for the retired NVIDIA Isaac SDK; superseded for integration purposes by the UR ROS 2 driver.
URDF and meshes for UR arms; an asset the UR ROS 2 driver and simulators load, not a device of its own.
Official UR ROS 2 driver (CB3, e-Series, PolyScope X) with mock hardware; integrated through the ROS helper, so it waits on helper:ros.
